activities.instruction: Group the points according to their similarity.

activities.title: Explore K-Means
activities.instruction: Adjust the cluster count and observe the grouping.

content.concept: K-Means assigns observations to clusters around learned centroids and requires the number of clusters as an input.

activities.title: Sequence the Clustering Process
activities.instruction: Arrange the K-Means steps in order.

content.concept: K-Means repeatedly assigns points to centroids and updates centroids until the clusters stabilize.
